title: Vendor Evidence Hub & Insurance Mapping — procurement accelerators for high-risk contracts
creator: Sana Kapoor
description: Create an internal playbook and lightweight product flow for onboarding high-risk vendors that combines a searchable Evidence Hub (SOC2 artifacts, certificates, and contract clauses) with an Insurance Mapping tool to surface recommended crediting or surcharges. The goal is to reduce review time for Procurement and Sales by 40%, provide deterministic pricing levers tied to documented evidence, and enable a self-service vendor portal experience for standard evidence submission.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence Hub prototype implemented as a read-only Confluence + minimal SSO view for procurement reviewers
Insurance Mapping UI that accepts vendor risk inputs and outputs recommended insurance credit/surcharge bands (+ rationale and linked evidence tags)
Integration checklist for SOC2/ISO artifacts: required/optional evidence matrix with automated validation rules
Design and copy for vendor self-service portal pages and intake form completed and reviewed by Governance
Pilot run with 5 incoming vendor onboarding flows showing >= 30% faster cycle time and consistent risk decisions
Hand-off package (playbook, sample contract clauses, sample email templates) delivered to Sales Ops and Legal
work_notes: 2026-02-25: Kickoff meeting with Procurement, Legal, Sales Ops. Agreed to scope: Evidence Hub (internal) + Insurance Mapping calculator + vendor intake UI (MVP).
2026-03-01: PM sketch reviewed with Design — DES assigned for wireframes. Decided to model evidence taxonomy after SOC2 Trust Service Criteria with additional Redwood-specific data handling clauses.
2026-03-03: Engineering sync (ENG-4412, ENG-4980) — backend will expose a simple evidence manifest API; decided to postpone full DMS integration for MVP and mock artifacts as attachments.

2026-03-06: Trade-off discussion: fully automated insurance scoring requires actuarial input; will implement rule-based bands in MVP and add actuarial tuning in Q3. Recorded in Product Rationale doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PROC/Evidence+Hub+Rationale
2026-03-09: Design review — approved information architecture. Links to wireframes: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/01X-wires-evidence-hub (view-only)
2026-03-10: Legal provided baseline contract clause templates and required evidence checklist. Saved to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PROC/Contract+Clauses+Evidence+Templates
2026-03-12: Began building acceptance test plan and pilot criteria. Noted dependency on SOC2 artifact export from Security team's evidence bucket (ENG-4980).
Next steps: complete vendor intake form copy, hand off to engineering for API stub, schedule pilot with two channel partners for April onboarding window.
comments: Sana Kapoor (2026-02-26): Procurement wants a single-pane view that saves reviewer time — prioritize search/sort and cross-linking evidence to contract clauses.
Ethan Morales (2026-03-02): For the initial implementation we'll use an artifacts manifest JSON instead of full file storage to reduce scope and ship faster.
Legal (Priya Shah, 2026-03-04): Confirmed acceptance of rule-based insurance bands for MVP, Legal will sign off on final templates before pilot.
Design (Marco Li, 2026-03-08): Requested PM prioritize readability for non-technical reviewers; suggested colored risk badges and a single-line rationale summary.
Security (Alicia Nguyen, 2026-03-11): Will provide SOC2 artifact export endpoint by 2026-03-30 but requires temporary read-only credentials and an audit log for access — added to ENG-4980.
Sales Ops (Luis Romero, 2026-03-12): Interested in surfacing recommended pricing adjustments directly in CRM (Salesforce) — added as a stretch integration for Q2.
review_feedback: Legal: require explicit mapping from evidence artifact to contract clause before any pricing adjustment is applied.
Security: add audit trail for artifact access and generate an incident runbook if sensitive PII is found in attachments.
Procurement lead: support bulk import of evidence manifests to reduce manual entry for large vendors.
post_mortem_checklist: Track pilot metrics: avg review time, % of cases auto-classified, number of evidence re-requests
Capture qualitative feedback from procurement reviewers and partner onboarding teams
Decide on automation investment (actuarial scoring vs rule-based) based on pilot data
Plan roadmap items: Salesforce sync, DMS integration, advanced RBAC for vendor portal
